The '''OT-7 Assault Droid''' was a bipedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A number of reprogrammed OT-7 Assault Droids were used by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]] in the [[Jacent Valley]] north of the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
